text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond missed 1st place, but 
racing alongside Kitasan Black was truly 
exhilarating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Responding to the cheering crowd, Kitasan 
Black declares her entry into the Osaka 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing that, Satono Diamond also 
declared her entry into the Osaka Hai. The 
crowd grew wildly excited for the rematch 
between the two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the waiting room, Satono 
Diamond said: Kitasan Black has already 
contributed to the Umamusume world simply 
by getting the crowd so excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, what should she accomplish as a 
"Notable Umamusume"? She stated that, 
taking cues from Kitasan Black, she wants 
to reflect on how she ought to carry 
herself.
